scope: Independent read-only source review of the frozen offline rechecker and its tests; records existing host-test and partial-probe receipts without rerunning them.
writes_limited_to: This new review.json only; no source, generated RTL, checker, original campaign result or raw log modified.

review_items.basis: Exactly 12 expected jobs; unexpected directories rejected. Full audit requires completed named receipts, timestamps, final state and summary agreement. Running or absent jobs cannot yield a full pass.

Six original driver/checker files loaded from the exact original 40-hex source commit via Git blobs and checked against original preflight hashes. Current checkout contents do not replace original checker bytes; original analyzer is installed before importing original control checker.
Pinned build source and input identities checked, hardware paths matched to build-source Git blobs, original preflight rerun with its bound code, and binary/reference/dependency identities verified.

Command, image, reference, flash, EMU and negative target bind to receipts. All three original raw log hashes verified; combined run.log must byte-equal stderr.log plus stdout.log; typed result exit code agrees with the exact exit-code file. Normalization affects only parser input.

Original completed-job receipts, runtime, exit and raw logs plus campaign metadata are hashed before and after. New outputs and checker snapshots go to a separate output directory; original result files are not rewritten.

Separate identified ANSI-aware gate requires intended bit-100 mismatch identity, exit 1 and canonical adjacent abort; raw stdout adjacency is checked directly. Ordinary jobs require exit 0 without failure markers.
Completed-only always yields O1_PARTIAL_AUDIT with whole_suite_pass false, even if all selected checks pass. Confirmed in existing probe02 receipt.

Full assessment retains original suite obligations, 12 completed jobs, normal-reference same-image recovery after the negative run, seven legacy control coverage requirements, independent dense HANDOFF greater than zero and 12 calibrated windows. Local control handoff absence remains explicit.

Nine existing passing host tests cover inventory/completion, raw preservation, tampering, exit/reference/input binding, partial verdict, final campaign metadata and original Git-blob provenance; source hashes match the reviewed frozen files.

finding: No concrete false-pass or original-evidence mutation defect identified in the reviewed frozen rechecker and test code.
limitations: This is source review plus verification of already-produced receipts, not formal proof and not a new execution of tests or EMU.
Probe02 checks only hello-vadd and negative-vdot; the ten missing jobs are not verified by this receipt.
The original campaign was RUNNING in the probe snapshot. This review does not certify that the full campaign has completed or passed.
Final whole-suite evidence requires a separate audit after all original jobs and final campaign metadata are complete.
No fullcore performance, speedup, timing closure, area or power conclusion is supported.
